notes.title: Release date confirmed – hell will be unleashed 17th October!
notes.notes:
Hell is round the corner... Happy to share the news that the release date has been locked down and Demon Pit will be available to download on Steam from Thursday, 17th October. Not long to wait before you can annihilate the hellion legions, or suffer eternal damnation as they feed on your soul. 

[previewyoutube=LAbWZblwj78;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget there's a demo available to download for free right now on the Demon Pit store page – hit the widget below to get there and look for the 'Download Demo' button on the right-hand side of the page. Oh, and add Demon Pit to your Wishlist while you're there. Every Wishlist helps, even in Hell. 

The pit awaits! 

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/548240/Demon_Pit/
